consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1990-02-27 show at Oakland Arena was a memorable performance, particularly highlighting the Mardi Gras-themed segments and the relaxed vibe throughout the night. The second set, especially the Drums > Iko > Women Smarter sequence, received consistent praise for its energy and musicianship.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 29 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the unique atmosphere and specific performances, there were also notable criticisms regarding the overall energy and pacing of the show.
